claims.hypothesis: The submm sources in the XCS J2215 core are cluster members
claims.experiment: ALMA 1.25 mm mosaic plus CO and MUSE [OII] redshifts
claims.result: 14 sources; 11 spectroscopically confirmed members, 1 interloper, 2 photo-z consistent
claims.finding: The bulk (>=11/14) are U/LIRGs in the cluster

evidence.quote: This suggests that the bulk ($\geq$ 11/14, $\sim$ 80%) of the submillimetre sources in the field are in fact luminous infrared galaxies lying within this young cluster.

claims.hypothesis: Environment has reduced the cool gas and dust in cluster LIRGs
claims.experiment: Compare CO luminosities, FWHM and LIR with field galaxies
claims.result: Lower CO(2-1) luminosity at fixed FWHM; narrower CO(2-1) than CO(5-4)
claims.finding: Tentative hints of stripping of cool gas

evidence.quote: We find hints that the cooler dust and gas components within these galaxies may have been influenced by their environment

claims.hypothesis: These LIRGs are progenitors of massive local early-type cluster galaxies
claims.experiment: Compare dynamical masses and expected ages with local cluster early types
claims.result: Five of six have similar properties

evidence.quote: most (five out of six) of the $^{12}$CO-detected LIRGs in XCS J2215 have characteristics similar to those expected for the progenitors

why_this_data.value: High resolution needed to identify counterparts of single-dish submm sources

evidence.quote: uncertainties in reliably identifying the counterparts of far-infrared/submillimetre sources at other wavelengths, due to the typically poor spatial resolution

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Milky Way-like alpha_CO~4.4 rejected for at least IDs 6 and 7 as it gives gas fractions >1

evidence.quote: a Milky Way-like $\alpha_{\rm CO}\sim 4.4$ is an inappropriate conversion factor to use

limitations_admitted.value: Gas and dynamical masses depend strongly on alpha_CO and assumed radius/inclination; comparison samples are small

evidence.quote: We note that the derived values are highly dependant on the value of $\alpha_{\rm CO}$

limitations_admitted.value: FIR luminosities may be unreliable and driven by 1.25 mm flux

evidence.quote: This may indicate that the far-infrared luminosities may be less reliable
